## Problem and result / 问题与结果

Describe the trigger and resulting behavior. Link the related issue if available.

## Validation / 验证

List checks actually run, distinguish fixtures from real native behavior, and state what remains unverified. Include sanitized screenshots for UI changes.

## Compatibility / 兼容性

Describe any data, permission, dependency, or platform changes. Write “none” when not applicable.

- [ ] I have the right to contribute this work under the repository's license and have retained required third-party attribution.
- [ ] I checked that the change does not include credentials, private research data, or generated runtime files.
- [ ] I updated affected documentation and accurately described unimplemented or untested behavior.
